answers.core: The android path seems to be controlled by core Godot; I'm not sure an add-on could easily fix this, and it's something that I would imagine every Android developer would want.
answers.workaround: Of course, I could have different git branches and merge frequently, or maybe it turns out that everything that gets overwritten shouldn't go into version control -- but the gitignore functionality for Android doesn't seem to be quite there yet, per [this comment](https://github.com/godotengine/godot-proposals/issues/1813#issuecomment-926983202) -- and the gitignore linked from that comment wouldn't work for me, because my build.gradle file has custom stuff to work around Play Games Services v2 badness.

title: Add support for multiple Android custom build export directories
